messages:
julia.kim: Found something odd in CI artifacts for the payment-service build: a file called `deploy.log.gz` contains what looks like a Vault ciphertext and an IAM email in plaintext. Not sure if it's a wrapped token or raw key.
omar.zhao: can you paste the artifact link? we need to snapshot before anyone deletes.
julia.kim: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/pay-service/ci/4123/deploy.log.gz — extracted snippet: `vault:v1:AAABBBccc...==` and `serviceAccount: payments@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`
ops-bot: Incident-Alert: possible secrets in CI artifact (channel: #eng-security). Created ticket SEC-INC-2026-558.
nicole_park: thanks julia. first actions: 1) snapshot artifact and copy to secure bucket for forensics, 2) search for similar artifacts across last 14 days, 3) revoke or rotate any keys the artifact exposes.
security-oncall: set priority P2. legal notified for retention policy. preserve original artifact; do not purge until legal signs off.
omar.zhao: quick triage: vault cipher could be either transit-wrapped ciphertext or a response-wrapping token output. if it's transit ciphertext, the underlying plaintext isn't directly exposed unless transit key or vault plaintext store is compromised. if it's response-wrapping token, it might unwrap if someone had the token. we need to know which.
julia.kim: i pulled the wrapped blob to secure bucket `gs://sec-incidents/SEC-INC-2026-558/orig.gz` and ran `file` — gzip text. i grepped for `vault:` and got 3 matches in that pipeline.
infra-automation: runbook step: run `vault token lookup` only via the vault admin host. do not paste tokens in chat.
nicole_park: audit plan:
- run `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="build" AND textPayload:vault' --project=redwood-ci --freshness=14d'` to find other occurrences
- search GCS for objects with names matching `*deploy.log*` and run quick grep for `vault:`
- `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:payments@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --freshness=30d'` to see bearer usage

omar.zhao: RBAC mitigation: temporarily remove `roles/iam.serviceAccountKeyAdmin` from payments SA and instead give `roles/iam.serviceAccountViewer` until we confirm no keys were created. That reduces new key creation risk.
security-oncall: good. also enable audit export for Vault: ensure `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log` (if not already) and export logs to secure bucket.
julia.kim: who's able to change the SA role? i can submit the gcloud command but need an approver to run it in prod.
omar.zhao: i'll take it. running: `gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:payments@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountKeyAdmin` and then add viewer role. posting logs to ticket.
ops-bot: SEC-INC-2026-558 updated: actions assigned (snapshot-artifact, search-artifacts, revoke-keys, dump-audit-logs).
nicole_park: rotation strategy: if we confirm a service account key id in artifacts, rotate with `gcloud iam service-accounts keys create --iam-account=payments@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com new-key.json` then revoke old ones. push new-key.json into Vault at `secret/ci/payment-service/key` and set a TTL policy (e.g., 6h) for CI jobs until workload identity is enabled.
omar.zhao: also add a Vault policy change: restrict `secret/ci/*` write to `ci-runner` principal only, and forbid printing secret contents in logs via policy `disallow-raw-output` in our CI templates.
julia.kim: found an entry referencing `transit:ingest-key` which means the blob is transit ciphertext. transit key looks fine, no suspicious IAM audit entries yet. still need to rewrap any ciphertexts that were created using a key when that key might have exposed symmetric material elsewhere.
security-oncall: coordinate with infra to run `vault write -f transit/rewrap key=ingest-key ciphertext="<blob>"` for ciphertexts we own. but do not mass rewrap until we confirm scope. we should also rotate the transit key if there's any risk of key material compromise.
infra-automation: automation note: we can bulk rewrap via script that pulls ciphertext list from KV metadata and calls transit/rewrap per entry. will test in staging first. creating follow-up OPS ticket OPS-909.
ops-bot: Note: Forensics reminder 1: export CI logs: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="build" AND logName:"projects/redwood-ci/logs/build"' --limit=1000 --format=json > ci_builds.json` and attach to SEC-INC-2026-558.
nicolE_park: (typo) sorry, nicole here. confirmed grep across CI artifacts returned 12 artifacts in last 7 days. i've uploaded list to the ticket with checksums.
omar.zhao: action: i'm reverting permissions for payments SA now. will also request a key rotation window for T+30m.
julia.kim: we should also add a CI linter that fails builds if any environment variable or file includes PEM-looking blocks or `vault:` prefixes. that would have prevented inclusion.
security-oncall: agree. add SCRUB-ENGINE ticket for detection and block. also enable Sentry and Logging scrubbing for outgoing error payloads to remove `Authorization` headers and `vault:` patterns.
infra-automation: partner note: if any downstream partners pulled artifacts, ask them to rotate any cached keys. sending template message now.
ops-bot: SEC-INC-2026-558: status changed to Investigating -> Mitigating.
julia.kim: completed snapshot and artifact list uploaded. starting a targeted search in the 14d window.
omar.zhao: keys: there is one key id `01a2b3c4` created 9 days ago by CI account. i'm scheduling a rotation: create new key, update Vault, then revoke old key. will document exact commands in the ticket.
nicole_park: after rotation, we need to re-encrypt any Vault KV values if they reference the old key id in metadata. run `vault kv metadata get secret/ci/payment-service` and inspect `created_by` fields.
infra-automation: running a dry-run rewrap in staging for 50 entries now. no regressions. will run in prod at T+50m once legal confirms retention.
security-oncall: please capture audit exports before any bulk ops. GCP, Vault, and CI provider logs must be preserved.
ops-bot: Reminder: runbook link https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/ci-secret-exposure.
julia.kim: rotating now: created new key and pushed to Vault path `secret/ci/payment-service/key` with `ttl=6h` for CI. will follow up when old key is revoked.
omar.zhao: old key revoked. posted revocation id and timestamp in ticket.
nicole_park: follow-ups: techdebt ticket TD-777 (CI linter), SECURITY-507 (Sentry/Logging scrubbing), OPS-909 (bulk-vault-rewrap), and IAM-312 (move payment-service to workload-identity).
security-oncall: nice work. please prepare a short incident summary for tomorrow sync and include mitigations and timeline. SEC-INC-2026-558 will remain open until we finish CI linter rollout and workload-identity migration plan is approved.
ops-bot: SEC-INC-2026-558 transitioned to Monitoring; assignees: julia.kim, omar.zhao, nicole_park.
